title: Hummingbird — Cafe Style
description: A lush, old-fashioned Southern classic — moist, fragrant, packed with fruit, and crowned with cream cheese frosting.

method.instruction: Preheat oven to 170°C. Grease a 28 cm round cake tin and dust with flour, shaking out any excess.
Place all cake ingredients — sifted flour, caster sugar, cinnamon, bi-carb soda, eggs, oil, mashed bananas, pecans, and crushed pineapple with syrup — into the bowl of a stand mixer.
Mix on low speed until just combined. Stop as soon as the dry ingredients disappear. Do not overmix.
Pour batter into the prepared tin and level the top.
Bake for approximately 1 hour 45 minutes, or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean. If the top browns too quickly, cover loosely with foil after the first hour.
Stand cake in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely.
For the frosting: place cream cheese, sour cream, butter, and vanilla extract into the stand mixer bowl. Beat with the paddle attachment until light and fluffy.
Gradually add sifted icing sugar while mixing on low speed until thick and silky.
Spread frosting thickly over the completely cooled cake.

notes.title: One-Bowl Method
notes.content: All cake ingredients go in together. Mix only until just combined on low speed — overmixing develops gluten and makes the cake tough. A few small streaks of flour are fine.

notes.title: Long Bake
notes.content: This is a heavy, wet batter that needs time. If the top is browning too fast after the first hour, cover loosely with foil and continue baking until the skewer comes out clean.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Keep refrigerated due to the cream cheese frosting. Bring to room temperature before serving. The cake improves overnight as the flavours meld — it is even better on day two.
